source.description: The NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 dataset is comprised of global downscaled climate scenarios derived from the General Circulation Model (GCM) runs conducted under the Coupled Model Intercomparison Project Phase 6 (CMIP6)
source.license_note: Read from each file's cmip6_license attribute, as Tech Note section 7 directs. tasmax: CC BY-SA 4.0 for every file; pr: CC BY 4.0, except GISS-E2-1-G, CC0 1.0.

method.grid: 0.25 degree, about 25 km; a cell counts toward a county when its centre is inside the county (Census 2024 cartographic boundary)
method.weighting: equal weight per cell; cos-latitude weights would differ by under 2 percent of a cell's weight across any of these counties
method.per_year: each metric is computed per cell for each year of the model's own calendar, averaged over the 20 years, then over the county's cells

metrics_detail.tmax_annual: mean of the daily maximum over the year
metrics_detail.tmax_summer: mean of the daily maximum over days dated May to September
metrics_detail.days_95: count of days with daily maximum at or above 35 degC (95 F) in each model year, averaged over years; a 365-day model year counts no 29 February
metrics_detail.pr_annual: sum of the daily precipitation totals over each model year, in inches

method.units: the pull stores tasmax in degC (NASA files: K) and pr in mm/day (NASA files: kg m-2 s-1); F = degC x 9/5 + 32; inches = mm / 25.4

model_left_out.reason: left out of the planned eight to fit a 200 GB download cap

method.variants: one realization per model: r1i1p1f1, or r1i1p1f2 for CNRM-ESM2-1 and GISS-E2-1-G
method.spread: median of seven models, with the lowest and highest model as the range; equal model weight; descriptive spread under one scenario, not a probability
method.change: per model, 2040-2059 minus that model's 1995-2014, then the median, lowest, and highest of the seven
method.counties_note: the 71 counties of the pull, drawn from a working list of proposals and utility requests; named_in_projects marks the counties a record in projects.json names, and data_center_50mw those where one is a data center of 50 MW or more
method.inputs_note: 840 files read; NASA source files streamed for them: 193.2 GB, each md5-checked against NASA's index by the TCR extractor

tmax_summer.label: Daytime high, May to September mean
